messages:
incident-bot: PAGER triggered — high latency detected for route /v1/generate on dedicated-us-west-2 (model: redwood/llama2-13b). p95 > 1s for 5m. paging primary oncall @Alex and secondary @Maya :rotating_light:
Alex: I'm primary, on it. grabbing metrics + checking autoscaler.
Maya: I'm on standby but need to sign off in ~2h for the holiday window — can we land a stable secondary for the evening?
Alex: Noted. @Sam can you take the late-evening secondary (20:00 UTC onwards)?
Sam: I can pick up 20:00-23:00 UTC. Have a 30m sync at 21:00 but will stay reachable.
Priya: I can cover 21:00-00:00 UTC if Sam needs the earlier block covered.
Alex: Running quick check: `rictl metrics --model redwood/llama2-13b --region us-west-2 --window 5m --metric p95_latency`
Alex: output:
```
p95_latency: 1250ms
requests: 4.2k/min
error_rate: 0.6%
kv_cache_hit: 12%
```
Jordan: I see a correlated spike in concurrent sessions from scribe.ai around +500 concurrent; likely cache cold starts after today's canary. Autoscaler also logged failures.
Maya: autoscaler error from orchestrator (excerpt):
```
2026-03-14T18:02:11Z scale: failed to allocate 1xA100: quota_exceeded: requested 1, available 0
2026-03-14T18:02:12Z pool: dedicated-us-west-2-a state=degraded
```
Maya: that explains the throttle. runbook pointer: https://redwood/runbooks/latency-spike-cache (see section "autoscaler quota fallback").
Alex: Customer impact assessment: initial instrumenting shows ~8% of requests experiencing >1s latency, degraded UX for some interactive customers. CS pinged and flagged 3 customer complaints so far.
Sam: Temporary mitigation I'll try now: shift 30% of /v1/generate traffic to smaller quantized variant and route overflow to us-east-1 backup pool. Command: `rictl route update --route /v1/generate --policy split --variant redwood/llama2-13b-int8:30% --region-fallback us-east-1`
Alex: Also enabling KV warmup for top prefixes from scribe.ai: `rictl cache warmup --model redwood/llama2-13b --prefix scribe-ai --concurrency 8`
Priya: I'll open a short maintenance note for CS with expected timeline: reduced latency within 15-25 mins if warmup succeeds, else fallback to us-east will keep success rate but higher cross-region latency.
Jordan: Monitoring: I'll keep alert thresholds lowered for the next 45m and watch for autoscaler recoveries. If quota_exceeded persists, we escalate to infra-allocations team.
Alex: Action summary and handoff plan:
- Alex: continue diagnostics + coordinate infra escalation if autoscaler doesn't recover in 15m.
- Sam: take secondary from 20:00 UTC, handle traffic split and monitor SLAs.
- Priya: cover Sam's 21:00-24:00 gap and update CS.
- Jordan: runbook owner for the incident, watch metrics and error spikes.
- Maya: I'm leaving troubleshooting notes + exact commands I ran in the runbook and will be contactable for 30 more minutes.
Maya: Handoff snippet I'll paste into the runbook now:
```
Handoff (Maya -> Sam/Priya):
- Known cause: autoscaler quota_exceeded in dedicated-us-west-2, likely due to canary burst.
- Current mitigations: 30% traffic split to int8 variant, KV cache warmup initiated.
- Commands to revert: `rictl route update --route /v1/generate --policy replace --variant redwood/llama2-13b:100%`
- Escalation: if p95 > 1.5s for >10m, page infra-allocations and open ticket with region team (include autoscaler logs).
```
Alex: great, thanks. Sam/Priya if anything changes tag this thread and ping @infra-alloc. If we can confirm warmup helps in 20m we can close the pager and mark as incident: mitigated.
Sam: taking note, will run smoke checks after split and post results here.
Priya: copied — I'll update CS and leave my contact in the thread. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident status update recorded (page acknowledged by Alex).
